# Closure fixture provenance

These three source archives are fictional packages authored for the repository
tests. They are generated only by `generate_fixture.R --update`, and test runs
use the checked-in bytes without rebuilding them. `--check` verifies every
archive against `SHA256SUMS` and never writes an archive.

The dependency closure is `root (LinkingTo: middle) -> middle (Imports: leaf)`;
all packages are version `0.1.0`. `middle` installs and calls `leaf`, and its
native source includes `inst/include/middle_marker.h`. `root` must include that
header while compiling.

`PACKAGES` is the checked-in plain index for this fixture repository. It pins the
exact index bytes consumed by the pak gate, including the sorted package records,
the `middle` import constraint, the `root` `LinkingTo` relationship, and the
folded UTF-8 description. Its fields and ordering follow the repository's
deterministic PACKAGES writer and the metadata/dependencies assembled by
`repository_r_interop.rs`; the bytes were reviewed against that logic rather
than generated by a release-time network operation. The archive generator only
creates and checks the three source archives and does not rewrite this index.
Normal checks verify the checked-in index digest and never update it.
